common.comingSoonText: This screen arrives in an upcoming step.

language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: Select the app language. You can change it later in settings.
language.enHint: Use the app in English for browsing, orders, and support.
language.frHint: Utilisez l'application en français pour commander et communiquer.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to keep shopping and track your orders.
login.verifyWithPhone: This account is not verified yet. Sign in with your phone number to receive the code.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join Kadou24h: shopping, delivery and jobs in one place.
register.name: Full name
register.intentVendorHint: After verification you'll complete your vendor application. An admin will review it.
register.intentRiderHint: After verification you'll complete your rider application. An admin will review it.
register.terms: By creating an account you accept the Kadou24h terms of use.

verify.title: Verify your number
verify.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code sent to {{target}}.
verify.subtitleBoth: Enter the 6-digit code sent to {{phone}} and {{email}}.
verify.missing: Verification timed out. Please start again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your phone number. We'll send you a code to choose a new password.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password to keep your account safe.
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.expired: Time is up. Request a new code.

ended.expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
ended.revoked: You were signed out on this device.

validation.identifier: Enter a valid phone number or email
validation.password: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.server: The server isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
errors.codeExpired: This code expired. Request a new one.
errors.waitSeconds: Wait {{count}}s before asking for a new code.
errors.phoneTaken: An account already uses this number. Please sign in.
errors.emailTaken: This email is already in use.
errors.socialAccount: This account uses Google or Apple. Continue with it, or reset your password.

guest.title: Sign in to continue
guest.orders: Sign in to see and track your orders.
guest.chat: Sign in to chat with sellers and riders.
guest.profile: Sign in to manage your account, addresses and preferences.

kyc.placeholder: The application form arrives in the next step. Your account is ready: you can already use Kadou24h as a customer.
